verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs cover fast availability checks: the suggestion tool checks availability instantly and bulk search shows results in seconds. Its AI search suggests alternate domain names and TLDs across 600+ extensions. Nothing in the pack addresses the 'honest' part of the story, a commitment not to front-run or squat on searched names. Missing for 10: any documented anti-front-running or no-squat policy on searched names, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and suggestion quality.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Get brandable domain ideas and check availability instantly across top TLDs.
